Hi Finance Ops,

Following up on the Sterling Industries payment reconciliation closeout: once you finish matching the remittance to the open invoices and updating the reconciliation note, please complete the CRM hygiene items we already aligned on so Audit can close the control.

**Action items (confirmed):**
1) Complete payment reconciliation for **Sterling Industries** (attach reconciliation note in CRM and mark as reconciled in the finance tracker).
2) As discussed, remove the two legacy customer accounts that are still present due to the duplicate/incorrect account creation during the migration:
   - **Horizon Manufacturing** (duplicate legacy shell)
   - **Summit Industries** (duplicate legacy shell)

Please delete both accounts (including associated stale contacts/opps) so they no longer appear in QBR exports.

Thanks,
Compliance Automation Desk
(SOC2 / Audit Controls)
